summary: Scanner 25 juin: Crisis mode maintained (probability 0.359) despite equity recovery (SPX -0.10%). Commodity crash accelerates — gold -3.2%, WTI -4.6%. Flight-to-quality: TLT +1.37%. VIX receded from 20.34 high to 18.63 (-4.4%). Portfolio 100% defensive: KO, MRK, LLY, CL, DUK. Triple data macro Thursday (GDP + Durables + Claims) + Core PCE Friday.

risks.label: Commodity crash — gold -3.2%, WTI -4.6%
risks.detail: Gold collapsed to $4,016 (-3.2%), WTI crude to $69.87 (-4.6%). Even traditional safe havens are being liquidated. This signals either forced deleveraging or a growth scare. Historically, commodity crashes precede equity corrections by 5-10 days.

risks.label: Crisis probability 35.9% — above regime flip threshold
risks.detail: Ensemble model: early_risk_off 38.8% (dominant), crisis 35.9%, neutral 19.3%, risk_on 6.1%. Expected drawdown 6.1% over 5 days. Regime score 27.5. Crisis mode active (>0.30 threshold). Full CRISIS if VIX sustains above 20.

risks.label: Core PCE Friday — Fed's preferred inflation gauge
risks.detail: May Core PCE drops Friday Jun 26. Hot print (>0.3% MoM) = 10Y past 4.60% + crisis acceleration. Cold print (<0.2%) = relief rally. Coincides with Russell Reconstitution = extreme gamma conditions.

risks.label: VIX touched 20.34 intraday — fear spike
risks.detail: VIX hit 20.34 before settling at 18.63 (-4.4%). The intraday spike above 20 signals institutional hedging demand. A sustained close above 20 = volatility regime change. 50D avg 17.76.

risks.label: Iran-Hormuz standoff — Day 5
risks.detail: Standoff continues. Oil falling sharply (-4.6%) as market calls bluff, but physical blockade risk remains. Escalation = Brent $95-100+ immediately. Monitor US Central Command.

risks.label: USD/JPY near BOJ intervention threshold
risks.detail: Approaching level that triggered intervention in 2024. If BOJ acts, expect 3-5% yen spike and Nikkei selloff. Watch for verbal jawboning from Japanese officials.

risks.label: Energy sector -2.8% — demand destruction narrative
risks.detail: WTI crude -4.6% to $69.87, dragging XLE -2.8%. If oil sustains below $70, energy capex cuts and layoffs follow. Confirms growth deceleration thesis.

events.label: GDP Q1 Final + Durable Goods + Jobless Claims Thursday
events.detail: Triple data release June 25. GDP final revision — downward = recession fears. Durables = capex health. Claims = labor market pulse. All three weak = crisis confirmation.

events.label: Core PCE + Russell Reconstitution Friday Jun 26
events.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge + year's biggest index rebalance on same day. Hot PCE + rebalancing = extreme volatility. Position sizing must account for Friday gamma.
